expo.name: Expense Tracker
expo.description:
Expense Tracker helps you understand your spending by automatically extracting transactions from your bank statement PDFs.

Instead of manually entering expenses, simply upload your statement and view all your transactions in one place.

Key features:
• Upload bank or credit card statement PDFs
• Automatic transaction extraction
• View transactions across multiple statements
• Clean and simple interface
• No manual data entry

Your data is processed securely and shown clearly, so you can focus on understanding your expenses without extra effort.

This app is designed for simplicity and clarity.
More features will be added over time.
